solution.text: $\mathrm{Cl}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}$ is the anhydride of $\mathrm{HClO}_{4}$. It reacts with water slowly to give perchloric acid. $\mathrm{Cl}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O} \longrightarrow \underset{\text { Perchloric acid }}{2 \mathrm{HClO}_{4}}$ Its structure is as follows: It is less reactive than other oxides of chlorine and does not react with $P, S,$ coal or paper at room temperature.
